crossRefs.note: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might…
it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother, Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
translations.bsb: Isaac did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.
translations.kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed
translations.asv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands. So he blessed him.
